title: Case-note extraction
description: One extractor result per note: exactly the five fields in docs/fields.md.

tax_year.description: The tax year the note names, such as 2023.

form.description: The form number only, such as "1040", without the word "Form".

issue.description: What looked wrong, in a short phrase of the note's own words.

amount_in_question.description: The amount the note names as in question, in whole dollars; null when the note names no amount.

next_action.description: What happens next, as the note says it.
